description: This file defines the AccountSyncOperation class, which manages a long-running synchronization process with a server, handling multiple roundtrips, payload management, and response processing.

classes.name: AccountSyncOperation
classes.description: Handles server synchronization with multiple roundtrips, managing payloads and responses in real time.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the sync operation with payloads, receiver callback, sync tokens, and API service.

methods.name: payloadsSavedOrSaving
methods.description: Returns payloads that are saved or currently in flight.

methods.name: popPayloads
methods.description: Removes and returns a specified number of payloads from the pending list.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the synchronization process, handling server responses and recursive calls until complete.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Checks if the synchronization process is complete.

methods.name: numberOfItemsInvolved
methods.description: Calculates total number of items involved across all responses.
